title: FY2024–25 Annual Report — consolidated financial statements

pages.summary: Reviewed consolidated financial statements for FY2024–25 with FY2023–24 comparisons. Original amounts are INR thousand; displayed amounts are normalized to INR crore. Approval/report date is not asserted as publication date. Banking accounts: revenue, PBT and EBITDA have not been normalized or inferred.
